Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the primary source’s date. The Fordham Medieval Sourcebook explicitly annotates the storm as occurring on the vigil of St. Mark, Wednesday April 24, 1191, but the Planner converted this to April 25. This led to an incorrect specific date (though the year 1191 remained correct), reflecting an over-interpretation beyond the task’s requirement.
